name: Thang co
summary: Thắng cố is the northwest highland stew of horse or buffalo meat and offal, simmered with thảo quả, cinnamon, and star anise. In Sa Pa it comes with a cup of rượu ngô.
origin: Mong, Tay, and Thai kitchens of the northwest highlands. The pot is horse, or buffalo, with the offal cooked in the same broth.
culture: It is feast food for guests, festivals, and village visits. At Cát Cát it was on the Gầu Tào stalls on 28 February 2026.
taste: The pot has a strong, gamey ngai ngái smell, and the first spoonful can take getting used to.
howToEat: Eat it from the shared pot and drink rượu ngô alongside, the way highland meals pair them.
where: Cát Cát when Gầu Tào is on, and Anh Dũng on Xuân Viên, which lists thắng cố ngựa. The Vân Sam buffet at the Fansipan cable station has also listed it.
seoTitle: Thang co in Sapa — horse or buffalo stew with corn wine
seoDescription: Thắng cố, the northwest stew of horse or buffalo meat and offal with thảo quả, cinnamon, and star anise, eaten in Sa Pa with rượu ngô.
